name: Vegetarian Mapo Tofu
ingredients: 300 g soft or medium-firm tofu, cubed
3 garlic cloves and 2.5 cm ginger, minced
1 tbsp doubanjiang (chilli bean paste; check the label)
1 tsp cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water
steps: Simmer the tofu cubes in lightly salted water for 3 minutes to firm them; drain gently.
Heat the oil and dry-fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the garlic, ginger and doubanjiang and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and soy sauce, add the tofu and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornflour paste to thicken; finish with Sichuan pepper and spring onion.
note: Minced mushrooms replace the pork in the traditional dish; doubanjiang is salty, so no other salt is needed.
